findings.title: Missing material specification for 2440 m of work
findings.message: The position lists 2440 m with an unit price of €0.60 but does not specify the type of material or work (e.g., earthwork, fill, demolition). According to VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 the description must be unambiguous and exhaustive.
findings.suggestion: Add a clear material class and technical details (e.g., “Erdreich, Klasse 2, 0,5 m³/m” or similar) to comply with VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.

findings.title: Unspecified single unit item
findings.message: Position 2.1.460 lists 1 St with €650.00 but lacks a description of what the single unit is (e.g., machine, material, service). VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 requires a clear definition.
findings.suggestion: Specify the item (e.g., “1 St. Baumaschine Typ X”) and include relevant technical data.

findings.title: Unspecified material for 545.27 m³
findings.message: The position provides a very low unit price (€0.34) for 545.27 m³ without indicating the material type. This violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 and may lead to underpricing.
findings.suggestion: Add material class, density, and relevant standards (e.g., “Sand, Klasse 1, DIN 18331”).
